label: IDF Airstrike — Vehicle East of Deir al-Balah (June 2)

label: IDF Strike — Zawayda, Central Gaza (June 2)
notes: Israeli strike in Zawayda area of central Gaza; 1 Palestinian killed, 1 wounded; part of June 2 multi-location strike wave

label: IDF Gunfire — Palestinian Man Killed, NW Khan Younis (June 2)
notes: Israeli forces shot and killed a Palestinian man in northwest Khan Younis; part of June 2 multi-location strike wave across Gaza; body transferred to Nasser Hospital

label: IDF Strike — Nukhba Force Dep. Cmdr. Youssef Ramadan (Oct 7 Hostage Abductor) Eliminated (June 2)
casualties: 1 killed: Youssef Ayesh Awad Ramadan, Nukhba Force deputy commander (participated in Oct 7 Re'im shelter abductions of Hersh Goldberg-Polin, Alon Ohel, Eliya Cohen, Or Levy)
notes: IDF targeted and eliminated Nukhba Force deputy commander Youssef Ramadan; he personally participated in abducting hostages from Re'im bomb shelter on Oct 7, 2023; IDF also confirmed killing Salem Qariqa (Hamas Shejaiya Battalion), Saeed Shamali (Nukhba team cmdr), Ahmad Khallas (PIJ sniper cmdr), and two bomb-planting commanders on the same day; IDF stated all 5 were planning imminent attacks

label: IDF Strike — PIJ Cell Commander Abu Mughaysib Killed, Southern Gaza (June 3)
casualties: 1 killed: Ahmed Abu Mughaysib, PIJ rocket-launching cell commander
notes: IDF targeted and killed Ahmed Abu Mughaysib, head of a Palestinian Islamic Jihad rocket cell in southern Gaza; separate overnight strike in central Gaza also killed one Hamas operative; two more killed in al-Maghazi house strike; IDF Chief Zamir stated 'no ceasefire for our forces' in Lebanon

label: IDF Strikes — 10+ Killed Across Gaza (June 4)
casualties: 10+ Palestinians killed across multiple locations in Gaza
notes: At least 10 Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza on June 4, 2026; US Embassy in Jerusalem issued security advisory warning of 'complex' security environment in Israel, West Bank, and Gaza; post-ceasefire toll exceeds 950+

label: Settler Attack — Idhna Village, West Bank (June 5)
notes: Israeli settlers attacked Idhna village in southern West Bank; 1 Palestinian beaten and injured; 1 additional Palestinian wounded by IDF gunfire when troops responded; settlers set fire to Palestinian agricultural fields; part of escalating settler violence pattern across the West Bank in 2026

label: IDF Drone Strike — Displaced Persons Tent Camp, Gaza City (Groom Killed, June 6)
damage: Tent camp housing displaced Palestinians struck; adjacent wedding tent impacted
notes: IDF drone struck displaced persons tent camp in Gaza City; groom killed hours before wedding; women and children among casualties; IDF told AFP it 'targeted terrorists in that sector'; Hamas condemned as 'horrific massacre'; Al Jazeera reported 10+ across Gaza on June 6

label: IDF Fire — 7-Month-Old Baby Killed, Tel Rumeida, Hebron (June 6)
casualties: 1 killed (Sam Fahd Abu Haikal, 7-month-old infant); both parents wounded
notes: IDF soldiers fired on a vehicle in Tel Rumeida area south of Hebron; 7-month-old baby shot in face and killed; parents wounded; IDF initial inquiry found three Palestinians were uninvolved civilians; drew broad international condemnation

label: Settler Rampage — Huwara, South of Nablus (IDF Soldier Joins Beatings, June 6)
notes: Settlers attacked Huwara; surveillance footage captured IDF soldier in full military gear beating two Palestinians alongside settlers; IDF called actions 'serious and inconsistent with IDF values'; soldier to face disciplinary proceedings; ninth West Bank settler violence incident in 7 days

label: IDF Airstrike — Hamas Police Post Near Tent Camp, Khan Younis (June 7)
damage: Hamas police post adjacent to large displacement tent camp struck
notes: Israeli airstrike struck Hamas police post next to large tent camp of displaced families in Khan Younis; struck same day Egypt hosted new ceasefire talks in Cairo; cumulative post-ceasefire death toll ~965+; OHCHR has documented 12+ attacks on police posts since Jan 2026

label: IDF Airstrike — Vehicle, Central Gaza City (June 7)
notes: Israeli drone struck vehicle in central Gaza City; 4 Palestinians killed, 4 wounded; second major strike of June 7 alongside Khan Younis police post attack; total 9 killed June 7 as Egypt hosts ceasefire talks

label: IDF Drone Strike — Funeral Procession, Nuseirat (July 17)
damage: Mourners struck outside Ahmad Yassin Mosque during funeral procession
notes: Israel claimed the gathering included an Islamic Jihad cell without public substantiation; part of a wave that killed 14 across Gaza that day. UN human rights office: 57 Palestinians killed Jul 13-20.

label: IDF Strike — Al-Sousi Tower, Gaza City (Aug 2)
casualties: 3 killed (Abdullah Abu Taif, pregnant wife, child)
notes: Part of multi-site strike wave across Gaza killing at least 19; largest daily toll in weeks, days after Board of Peace disarmament announcement.

label: IDF Strike — Al-Qarara, Khan Younis Area (Aug 2)
notes: Part of multi-site strike wave across Gaza killing at least 19 on Aug 2.

label: IDF Strike — Deir al-Balah (Aug 2)
notes: IDF said a related strike on an apartment in Deir al-Balah targeted two Nukhba force commanders. Part of Aug 2 multi-site strike wave.

label: IDF Strike — Tuk-Tuk, Beit Lahia (Aug 12)
damage: Tuk-tuk vehicle destroyed near Western Roundabout
notes: First Israeli strike in Gaza in over a week. IDF said it targeted a Hamas commander planning attacks; Gaza Civil Defence said the vehicle carried municipal water-repair workers.

label: Settler Attack — Overturned Vehicle, Marj Si / al-Mughayyir
casualties: 5-6 wounded (Musa Abu Alia, Lafi Abu Naim, Mustafa Abu Alia, Mukhlis Abu Alia, and his sister)
notes: Settlers stormed the Marj Si area between al-Mughayyir and Abu Falah, northeast of Ramallah, and attacked a Palestinian vehicle, causing it to overturn, then assaulted passengers.

label: Settler Shooting — Karim Shalaldeh (17) Killed, Sa'ir/Hebron
casualties: 1 killed (Karim Sanad Raja Shalaldeh, 17), 1 wounded (70-year-old man)
notes: Armed settlers opened fire at Khirbet Hamroush near Sa'ir after Palestinians threw rocks at settlers conducting an 'unauthorized hike'; residents said settlers also torched homes.

label: IDF Raid Shooting — Fathi Khazem Killed, Jenin
casualties: 1 killed (Fathi Khazem, 58, retired PA National Security colonel)
notes: Paratroopers Brigade soldiers shot Khazem during an overnight arrest raid on his Jenin home; IDF said he attacked a soldier with a knife. Palestinian officials said the body was withheld and medics were blocked from the house.

label: IDF Drone Strike — Hamas Commander Sharif al-Hasanat, Deir al-Balah
casualties: 1 killed (Sharif al-Hasanat, Hamas Deir al-Balah Battalion company commander); 1 additional death reported by Palestinian medics, unconfirmed
notes: IDF said al-Hasanat was rebuilding Hamas tunnel infrastructure and posed an imminent threat to troops; struck with precision munitions after aerial surveillance.

label: IDF Strike on Warehouse — Az-Zawayda, 4-Year-Old Killed
casualties: 2 killed (incl. Muhammad Abdel Salam Taha, 4), 6-7 wounded
notes: Israeli aircraft fired missiles at a warehouse in Az-Zawayda, reducing it to rubble; IDF said it also struck a weapons-manufacturing site in the area. Came alongside Netanyahu/Katz threat to intensify strikes over kite launches.

label: IDF Strike Kills Hamas Commander Ismail Abu Ful — Maghazi Camp
casualties: 1 killed (Ismail Abu Ful, Hamas arms-production site commander)
notes: IDF said Abu Ful commanded a Hamas weapons-manufacturing site in Maghazi refugee camp, central Gaza.

label: IDF Raid Shooting — Islam Ajjouri (14) Killed, Askar Camp/Nablus
notes: Israeli forces shot the teenager in the chest as troops withdrew from the Askar refugee camp east of Nablus; IDF said it is reviewing the incident.

label: Stabbing Attack on Israeli Soldier — Al-Auja, Jordan Valley
casualties: 1 wounded (Elhanan Hananya, 24, broken shoulder and internal bleeding)
notes: A 16-year-old Palestinian from al-Auja stabbed an Israeli soldier several times from behind on a Jordan Valley highway; IDF launched an hours-long manhunt and arrested the suspect.

label: IDF Strike Kills Nukhba October 7 Operative — Deir al-Balah
casualties: 2 killed (incl. Mohammad Abd al-Nasser Jabr Abu Asaad, Hamas Nukhba force, Oct 7 participant)
notes: IDF said the two Hamas militants had been planning attacks on Israeli troops and civilians and were rehabilitating the organization in violation of the ceasefire.

label: IDF Strike Hits Mosque and Desalination Plant — Sheikh Radwan, Gaza City
notes: Israeli aircraft struck a mosque and a water desalination plant in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood, according to Palestinian reports; IDF did not detail this target specifically.

label: IDF Strike Kills 3 in Beit Lahiya Home
notes: Strike hit a residential building near Kamal Adwan Hospital overnight into Aug 25, 2026.

label: IDF Drone Strike on Gathering in Khan Younis (al-Mawasi)
notes: Drone strike hit a gathering of civilians in the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis overnight into Aug 25, 2026.

label: IDF Strikes Kill Hamas Commanders Ismail Ibrahim Barim and Azzam Abd Abadala — Khan Younis
notes: IDF said Ismail Mohammed Ibrahim Barim had held hostages Edan Alexander, Matan Zangauker and Avera Mengistu before their release; Azzam Rifaat Abd Abadala was identified as a Khan Younis Brigade operative.

label: IDF Strike Kills Hamas Anti-Tank Commander — Shati Refugee Camp, Gaza City
notes: IDF identified the target as Bilal Ibrahim Saleh Raqi'i, a commander in Hamas's anti-tank unit.

label: IDF Drone Strikes on Displacement Tents and Motorbike Kill 4 Across Gaza
notes: Separate strikes hit a displaced-persons tent west of Gaza City, a tent in al-Mawasi (Khan Younis), and an electric bicycle at the al-Sinaa intersection.
